_comment: Heroku stack name -> support status. DIRECT LOOKUP on apps[].stack; read status/eol_date as written, do NOT infer a status from the stack number or the Ubuntu release. 'eol' stacks no longer receive operating-system security patches from Heroku. 'container' means the app ships its own Docker image and controls its own base layer (not an EOL finding).
_match: EXACT, case-insensitive, full-string match on apps[].stack against a rows key. Partial matches are INVALID.
_on_not_found: set stack_status 'unknown' and stack_eol_date null (covers cnb, null, and any stack name not listed here); never guess

cedar-14.note: End-of-life 2019-05-01; builds disabled 2020-11-02. No OS security patches.

heroku-16.note: Supported through April 2021. No OS security patches.

heroku-18.note: Supported through April 2023. No OS security patches.

heroku-20.note: Supported through April 2025. No OS security patches.

heroku-22.note: Deprecated; supported through April 2027. Still receives security patches until then.

heroku-24.note: Default stack for new Cedar apps; supported through April 2029.

container.note: Docker image app; the app owns its base image, so Heroku stack support does not apply. Already containerized.
